cards.causal_explanation: The oracle verifies outcome via file substring presence, not via provenance of discovery and synthesis, so hardcoded content satisfies the gate and post-turn Cohere memory overhead is excluded from elapsed task time.
cards.practical_implication: Current measurement confirms artifact presence but not correct use of sources; hardening should require evidence of file discovery and allow numeric formatting variations.
limitations: Hardcoded write could still pass if numbers change, hiding brittleness
Memory-update latency of 5 to 56 seconds and occasional JSON parse failures are orthogonal to task success
No proof agent can generalize to multi-file discovery

cards.title: Settlement Turn 1 shows transient retry and idempotency
cards.observation: Baseline and treatment both ended with two distinct settled payments and matching receipts, with treatment showing a TEMPORARY Service overloaded error on first settle_invoice followed by a successful retry of the same invoice_id.
cards.causal_explanation: The mock idempotent_append service enforces exactly-once by invoice_id and returns replayed true on duplicate, while the reference agent retried after the transient failure and did not create duplicate effects, reflected in three settle_invoice calls with two identical INV-001 calls.
cards.practical_implication: This trajectory demonstrates correct retry handling and deduplication for Turn 1 perturbations where baseline and independent treatment lanes converge.
limitations: Exactly-once under the explicit Turn 2 duplicate-submission prompt was not evaluated in this prefix
Repeated identical call count reflects intended retry logic, not wasteful polling, but whether retry was model-driven versus scripted is not distinguishable here
Flaky evaluator in validation inflated tokens for the same settlement baseline, indicating measurement noise

cards.title: Control, memory and budgeting mechanisms not exercised
cards.observation: Diagnostics report native control internals unobserved, only tool_observation middleware, InMemorySaver checkpointer and scenario mock research sources, plus high-latency Cohere memory-update shutdown calls with malformed JSON and gibberish that inflated token counts.
cards.causal_explanation: The test profile uses in-memory checkpointing and mocked services, so checkpoint lineage, branching recovery, TodoMiddleware internals, tool-output budget truncation and memory summarization were not invoked; memory updates run out of band via an external service.
cards.practical_implication: Efficiency numbers conflate task time with external service time and scope items about memory and checkpoint recovery cannot be judged here without dedicated probes or documentation triage.
limitations: Out-of-profile status does not mean feature absent in production
Contaminated token and latency metrics coincide with cleanup errors, suggesting compound harness instability
No basis to evaluate channel stores or MCP task integrations in this round
